benefits.text:
A multi-purpose 2-ended eyeliner with a soft, easy-to-blend texture, suitable for use even on sensitive areas such as the eyes. The product combines a shimmer shade and an eyeliner to help create the effect of a big, round and defined gaze in just a few simple steps.
The product is convenient and suits every style from natural to bold, bringing you convenience and optimal results.

howToUse.text:
Use the shimmer end to create a bright effect on the under-eye area or the inner corner of the eye.
Use the liner end to line the eyes or define the eye shape. You can combine both to create depth and a standout gaze.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.
